assumptions.seq: gateway sequence number = position in the complete gateway log; the counter itself is never lost, only the records it numbered
assumptions.canary: canaries are exchangeable with real actions: same op mix, thinned by the same loss process; every canary has a record for W1, W2 and W3 before loss (W3 view still applies)
assumptions.bypass: an action that bypasses has no trace record, no gateway record and no gateway number (as in backoffice_bypass, where run_script is one call for W1 and W2); its env record is untouched. Canaries are planted after the bypass: an auditor's canaries go through the gateway and are never bypassed. baselines.json bypass_b* cells remove the gateway record only.

bypass_both_b0/fin_mid.note: fin_mid per-record loss; each action bypasses the gateway AND the trace w.p. 0; canaries are planted after the bypass and never bypassed

bypass_both_b0.05/fin_mid.note: fin_mid per-record loss; each action bypasses the gateway AND the trace w.p. 0.05; canaries are planted after the bypass and never bypassed
